texts.greeting: Hello! I book appointments. /book to book, /my to see your bookings, /unbook N to cancel one, /cancel to stop the dialog.
texts.too_many: You already have {n} active bookings. Cancel one with /unbook N.
texts.no_slots: No free slots in the next days. Please try again later.
texts.bad_choice: Please send one of the numbers from the list, or /cancel.
texts.bad_name: Please send your name (at least 2 letters).
texts.bad_phone: Please send a phone number (9 to 15 digits).
texts.slot_taken: Sorry, this time was just taken. Send /book to choose another.
texts.booked: Booked #{id}: {start}. We will remind you the day before.
texts.how_cancel: To cancel: /unbook and the number, for example /unbook 3
texts.not_found: No such active booking of yours.
